# Example RMI Application

> One or two sentences on what the application does, who it is for, and what
> data or tools it provides. This is the most important line in the file.

This application is published by RMI. Data should be attributed to
"RMI, Example Application (year)". See the methodology for data sources,
limitations, and appropriate interpretation. Figures are estimates and
should not be presented as official statistics.

## Documentation

- [About](https://example.rmi.org/about): What the application does and who maintains it.
- [Methodology](https://example.rmi.org/methodology): Data sources, assumptions, and known limitations.
- [Data](https://example.rmi.org/data): Available datasets, formats, and update frequency.

## API

- [API documentation](https://example.rmi.org/api/docs): Endpoints, authentication, and rate limits.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://example.rmi.org/api/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description.

## Optional

- [Terms of use](https://example.rmi.org/terms): Licensing and acceptable use.
- [Changelog](https://example.rmi.org/changelog): Release history.
